title: Crispy {p} Larb with {v}
steps: Press and crumble the {p}, then toss with a spoonful of soy sauce and a little oil. Pan-fry in a large skillet over medium-high heat 10 to 12 minutes, stirring now and then, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Toast a spoonful of uncooked rice in a dry pan 5 minutes, until golden, and grind it to a coarse powder.
Whisk lime juice, the {sauce}, a pinch of sugar and chili flakes. Toss with the warm tofu, thinly sliced shallot, the toasted rice and the {spice}.
tip: Heap on the cabbage and cucumber so the tofu is only part of the plate.
